project_info.name: XUNISON
project_info.concept: A continuous 3D/WebGL cinematic scroll narrative showcasing the D71 Wi-Fi 7 Tri-Band Gateway, telemetry, AI optimization, and R&D Environmental Intelligence.
project_info.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast Performance Pro (Apple Product Launch x NVIDIA Tech Visualization x Premium Automotive)

heading.font_family: Space Grotesk, Syne, Cabinet Grotesk, sans-serif

narrative_signature.signature_story: TODAY Xunison connects devices. NOW Xunison helps service providers understand and manage networks. NEXT Xunison is exploring how connected networks can understand their surroundings.

scene_architecture.title: CONNECTIVITY, REIMAGINED.
scene_architecture.visuals: Photorealistic D71 unibody gateway on soft studio background with 3/4 slow orbital camera move, glowing ring antenna LED, Wi-Fi particle ignition.

scene_architecture.title: SMART WI-FI 7 TRI-BAND
scene_architecture.visuals: Three distinct overlapping spatial layers (2.4GHz Amber, 5GHz Cyan, 6GHz Purple). Interactive density slider demo toggling 5 -> 20 -> 50 device nodes.

scene_architecture.title: ELEGANT TOPOLOGY & ROUTING
scene_architecture.visuals: Connected mesh nodes with dynamic glowing data pulses flowing from client devices -> D71 -> Edge -> Cloud.

scene_architecture.title: EVERY CONNECTION CREATES DATA
scene_architecture.visuals: Thousands of telemetry data points organizing into real-time health waveforms, signal strength vectors, and packet distribution metrics.

scene_architecture.title: ABSTRACT DIGITAL CLOUD BRAIN
scene_architecture.visuals: High-density particle vortex forming an abstract neural computing cloud, reflecting central intelligence without cartoon icons.

scene_architecture.title: OBSERVE. UNDERSTAND. ACT.
scene_architecture.visuals: Normal network -> Node misbehaves (Rose alert) -> AI pattern highlight -> Neighbor analysis -> Automated optimization -> Health restored.

scene_architecture.title: EXPLORING ENVIRONMENTAL INTELLIGENCE
scene_architecture.visuals: 3D Architectural living room with human spatial silhouettes (no faces, no tracking boxes). Wireless wave distortion reveals movement patterns.

scene_architecture.title: THE INTELLIGENT ECOSYSTEM
scene_architecture.visuals: D71 -> Home -> Neighborhood -> Global Mesh -> Xunison Brand resolve + Lead Capture & Partner CTA.

motion_and_performance.scroll_timeline: Centralized normalized scroll progress value (0 to 1) passed to Three.js canvas & GSAP timeline.
motion_and_performance.accessibility: Detects `prefers-reduced-motion` and provides step-by-step section navigation tabs.
motion_and_performance.adaptive_canvas: Auto-scales particle counts and DPR based on frame rates (60fps target, auto-downscale on low-tier mobile).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required 3D and animation packages in /app/frontend using yarn: `three`, `@react-three/fiber`, `@react-three/drei`, `gsap`, `lenis`, `@studio-freight/lenis` or `@lenis/react`, `lucide-react`, `framer-motion`, `sonner`.
Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, scene controls, nav links, tabs) have explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-d71-link', data-testid='lead-submit-button').
Build the procedural D71 3D model in Three.js/R3F with matte white unibody, chamfered curves, metallic vents, rear ports, and glowing LED status ring.
Implement the 8 continuous scenes driven by scroll position with smooth camera interpolation and background color interpolation.
Do NOT use transparent headers; use glassmorphic blur with solid fallback background.
Ensure supporting modals or page tabs for Products, Technology, and Support exist so visitors can explore full technical specifications and ISP portal details.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid AI slop, default generic gradients, or boring centered boxes.
Use generous spacing (p-8, p-12, py-20, py-32).
Never rely on raw transparent backgrounds over 3D scenes without backdrop-blur.
Verify APCA / WCAG text contrast across light and dark scene transitions.
Maintain strict data-testid naming conventions across all pages.
